title: JRPG Edge of Memories Delayed to Avoid GTA 6 Release Window
description: French developer Midgar has delayed its JRPG-inspired game Edge of Memories to a quieter period, stepping out of the way of GTA 6's massive launch.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## JRPG Edge of Memories Delayed to Avoid GTA 6 Release Window

When a titan like Grand Theft Auto VI prepares to enter the market, developers across the industry must carefully weigh their release strategies. Avoiding a direct collision with Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster has proven to be a common theme for studios looking to secure their game's success.

### Stepping Out of the Shadow of Giants

According to a report by gaming outlet Push Square, French developer Midgar has decided to delay its JRPG-inspired title, *Edge of Memories*, moving it to a "quieter period" on PS5. The game had previously stood out as one of the few titles willing to go head-to-head with *GTA 6*.

*Edge of Memories* was originally scheduled to launch on 5th November—a date that also happens to coincide with the release of Nintendo's *Ocarina of Time* remake. Given the overwhelming attention *GTA 6* commands across the global gaming community, pivoting away from this congested launch window is widely seen as a pragmatic move. Industry observers often note that launching near such massive titles can easily drown out the marketing efforts of independent and mid-tier games, making a strategic delay the safest path forward.

### Editor's Take

It is hard to blame developer Midgar for blinking. Facing the monumental shadow of *GTA 6* is a daunting prospect for any studio. Pushing *Edge of Memories* to a quieter window gives the JRPG a much better chance to breathe and find its audience on the PS5.
